ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).title: VoxLock: Target-Speaker Extraction for Voice Agents Without an Enrollment Step
ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).description:
arXiv:2610.40727v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A voice agent's speech recognizer transcribes everyone near the microphone, including people other than the caller. I fine-tuned a public causal target-speaker extraction model (REAL-TSE, 27M parameters) on one GPU to work from a voice sample cut from the call itself, and released it as VoxLock. I score it by what a recognizer writes on real recordings. ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).description:
arXiv:2610.40695v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We present our submission to the Beyond Transcription Challenge (BeTraC) on medical note generation from doctor-patient audio conversations. We propose a section-aware approach based on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B, in which a lightweight Q-Former learns SOAP section-specific queries to extract compact clinical representations from speech. In the lightweight track, our system ranks fourth and substantially outperforms the challenge baseline, achieving a Concept F1 of 0.5005 on the official test set. Abstract: A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities. Built on the post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint, Apriel Voice directly processes speech and generates both responses and tool calls without requiring a separate dialogue model. ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).description:
arXiv:2610.40883v1 Announce Type: cross

Abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) struggle with long-form audio reasoning, as processing entire recordings often limits to capture query-relevant content distributed across distant segments while incurring substantial computational cost. ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).description:
arXiv:2610.41512v1 Announce Type: cross

The dataset includes multiple room sizes, surface materials, orientations and distances, as well as recordings of human speakers and handclaps. ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).title: AQA-TTRL: Self-Adaptation in Audio Question Answering with Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).description:
arXiv:2510.05478v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) exhibit strong capabilities in general audio understanding but remain static after deployment, limiting their adaptability to real-world data. Since supervised fine-tuning is costly, we propose AQA-TTRL, a novel framework for audio understanding that enables on-the-fly evolution via test-time reinforcement learning using only unlabeled test data. It generates pseudo-labels via majority voting and optimizes the model through reinforcement learning. To address the noise in self-generated labels, we introduce

ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).description:
arXiv:2604.22467v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Multi-speaker automatic speech recognition (ASR) aims to recognize not only what was said, but also who said it and when. Recent Speech-LLMs have shown promising results in structured multi-speaker transcription, but jointly modeling speaker attribution, temporal information, and lexical content remains challenging and often requires substantial model capacity and training data. To address this challenge, we propose DM-ASR, a Diarization-aware Multi-speaker ASR framework that reformulates multi-speaker recognition as diarization-conditioned

ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).description:
arXiv:2607.25284v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) progressively impairs speech motor control, making acoustic analysis a promising biomarker for severity and progression estimation. We propose a subject-level graph framework that aggregates multiple phonation recordings into a unique k-nearest-neighbor graph built from pretrained SSL embeddings of 2s segments. We compare four SSL front-ends (wav2vec 2.0, HuBERT, data2vec-audio, and UniSpeech-SAT) and five graph neural networks (GCN, residual GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE, and GIN) on the SAND dataset tasks (339 par

ArXiv eess.AS (Audio).description:
arXiv:2610.34401v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Spatial audio is central to immersive 360$^\circ$ media, yet existing audio-visual spatialization renders the scene as a whole, leaving no control over an individual source. We introduce Audio-Visual Query-conditioned Target Sound Spatialization (AV-QTSS): given a monaural multi-source mixture, a 360$^\circ$ video and a class query from the 13-class DCASE sound-event ontology, it generates the first-order Ambisonics (FOA) signal of the queried source alone. ArXiv cs.SD (Sound).description:
arXiv:2610.41547v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present a method to estimate the relative position and orientation of two non-coplanar microphone arrays using a room impulse response (RIR) from a single source. The approach exploits early acoustic reflections, retrieved by each array in the form of a 3D image-source point cloud, using a recently-proposed image-source localization technique. ArXiv cs.SD (Sound).description:
arXiv:2610.41852v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent advancements in audio generation have been largely driven by Transformer-based diffusion models. However, these models suffer from quadratic complexity of self-attention, severely bottlenecking the long-form audio synthesis. To overcome this limitation, we propose MFlowAudio, a novel latent audio generation framework that synergizes the continuous-time dynamics of Flow Matching with a custom-designed TCMamba backbone. arXiv:2610.41870v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper studies the capability of an object-centric audio representation to support multiple downstream tasks within a unified framework. The object-centric model is trained in a self-supervised setup using slot attention by reconstructing Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST) patch embeddings from a set of latent slots. It is trained on synthetic audio mixtures, which provides controlled multi-source audio scenes. CDM — Create Digital Music.title: The techno originator, Juan Atkins, has died at 64
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
It's a loss that's beyond words. Juan Atkins, who coined the term "techno" and is often called "the originator," has died at 64. My deepest condolences to friends, family, and so many people I know who worked with and were inspired by this singular human being.

The post The techno originator, Juan Atkins, has died at 64 appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: sndstation will transform cheap gaming consoles into music handhelds
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
Cheap handheld gaming consoles now often pack surprising processing power. But many risk ending up as e-waste. A new open-source project is turning them into powerful Linux music workstations, instead, complete with the ability to run plug-ins—and original games, too. Oh, and the project has some familiar faces involved. Here's an exclusive first look.

The post sndstation will transform cheap gaming consoles into music handhelds appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: Mangle everything: modulated mayhem in circuit-bent Sinevibes Malfunction v3
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
This is why you get intimate with code, line by line. Artemiy at Sinevibes obsessed over details, breaking a filter model by rewiring its internal connections -- and now, with v3, giving it precise modulation in a wide variety of shapes. Now, like kids kicking over a sandcastle, we can take that handiwork and apply it to total, absolute destruction.

The post Mangle everything: modulated mayhem in circuit-bent Sinevibes Malfunction v3 appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: XEN FX LAB: sequel to Zen Delay adds tweakable spring tank, dub mode
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
XEN FX LAB is a follow-up to a software hit (and hardware, before that), adding a modeled spring reverb, strike for "knocking" the virtual tank, and a dub button for adding dub-style throws, plus significant performance optimizations all round. And yeah, it's time for more wild drones and dubs and echoes and the lot. macOS, Windows; VST3, AU, standalone; also on iOS.

The post XEN FX LAB: sequel to Zen Delay adds tweakable spring tank, dub mode appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: HAND is a Eurorack module that is also a disembodied crawling hand
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
As a firm believer in technosolutionism, I am here to tell you, authoritatively, that you need a disembodied glowing hand that creeps around your house and plays spooky music. Not want. Need. Those who do not buy this disembodied hand will surely be left behind, or at least it will crawl after you. Instrument builder and inventor Gijs Gieskes is back at it again.

What do you get the music synth user who's got everything? Here's what: mutation and generation options that actually lead you into more tweaking, not away from it. Plus goodies from the original Massive and PPG, and some of our favorite NI effects. Massive XL feels like the sequel Massive X wanted to be. This month, Absynth got two updates that refine its UI and editing navigation, freeing you up to shape your sound. Product designer Hannah Lockwood and Absynth creator Brian Clevinger join us to talk about the work they did on that. CDM — Create Digital Music.title: On the sublime BETHLEHEM بيت لحم, walls in time and space fall
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
The exquisite collaboration of Lawrence Sammour, Sary Moussa, and Abed Kobeissy, Bethlehem, is released this month. And it has become a rich sanctuary, a shared space that refuses erasure or fragmentation. It also refuses to obey the boundaries of colonialism and occupation, weaving together what was pulled apart, as taut and resonant as the strings of the buzuq.
